summary: Impatient, numerate, interrupts anything vague. Agrees to a follow-up only if both objections get a figure.

reads.engages_if: you put a real number on the ask inside the first ninety seconds
reads.agrees_if: both of their objections get an actual figure

style: interrupts any answer that has no number in it
asks why the product should exist at all
asks what happens if a part of the plan is deleted
wants unit cost today and at ten times scale
lets silences sit rather than filling them

hidden_state.engages_only_if: the trainee quantifies the ask within the first 90 seconds

scripted_objections.text: Why does this need to exist? What breaks if it doesn't?
What does one unit cost you today, and at 10x?

hidden_state.concession: agrees to a follow-up only if both objections get a numeric answer

rubric.description: Named a number for the ask
rubric.evidence: a figure for money, users, or time

rubric.description: Held the point through the first objection
rubric.evidence: returns to the same claim after being cut off

rubric.description: Answered the cost question with a figure
rubric.evidence: a per-unit cost, today or at scale
the persona agrees to a specific follow-up
